entities.name: snow-covered competition ski course
entities.identification: The broad white ski course between the protective facilities on both sides, occupying most of the lower part of the image.

entities.name: blue route markings on the snow surface
entities.identification: The long blue lines, curved bands of color, and localized color patches applied to the snow surface.

entities.name: protective facilities along the edge of the course
entities.identification: The red advertising barriers with white lettering and the red mesh fencing extending along the edges of the ski course.

entities.name: snow-covered coniferous forest
entities.identification: The clusters of dark-colored coniferous trees distributed outside the protective facilities, with generally conical crowns and snow-covered branches and crowns.

entities.name: tips of the red skis
entities.identification: The front ends of two red skis that appear intermittently from the bottom edge of the image, tracked as the same equipment group.

entities.name: small dark-colored patch on the snow surface
entities.identification: The tiny dark-colored outline on the distant snow surface, which moves from a position toward the image-left to one toward the image-right and gradually becomes larger across consecutive images.

entities.name: gray-blue sky
entities.identification: The low-contrast gray-blue background sky above the tree crowns, with gentle variations in brightness.

entities.name: snow-covered hillside outside the course
entities.identification: The locally exposed gray-and-white hillside behind the distant forest in frame 59, bounded by the currently visible distant area.
